notes:
ARKhives 8.19.15

- Timestamp picture links survive saving and reopening DOCX notebooks. A normal click returns to the source; text links remain editable with Ctrl+click navigation.
- Divider dragging updates once per frame and postpones the expensive native notebook resize until release. Playback, the editor, selection and scroll stay in the same session.
- Replaced ambiguous dot controls with labeled Layout and Tools menus, with one menu open at a time and predictable Escape/outside-click behavior.
- Added subtle menu and lesson-tab transitions, pressed feedback and a divider percentage indicator. Reduced-motion settings remain respected.
- Kept the original ARKhives branding, pane-local loading animation, lesson captures, notes, progress and shared desktop/mobile learning compatibility.
